overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board approved the April–May 2018 minutes within 30 days of each meeting, and it declined to review the June–July minutes as not yet ripe.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board did not timely approve its April through May 2018 meeting minutes, approving none at its May 7, May 16, May 21, or May 24 meetings except two.
allegations.key_passage: After a review of the various meeting minutes, we conclude that the Board timely approved them.

allegations.summary: Complainant's allegation of untimely approval also covered minutes of the June 4, June 18, and July 10 meetings, which the AG declined to review because they were not yet ripe.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we decline to review the minutes for meetings held on June 4; June 18; and July 10.
